slots.root: flex flex-col gap-1 transition-[width] duration-[var(--dur-state)] ease-state motion-reduce:transition-none
slots.item: flex items-center gap-items min-h-ctl-h px-control-x py-2.5 rounded-control border-none cursor-pointer text-left no-underline font-body text-ctl shadow-control-rest active:scale-[var(--press-scale)] motion-reduce:active:scale-100
slots.badge: ms-auto inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-5 px-1.5 rounded-pill font-mono text-ctl-2xs font-bold tracking-badge
slots.sectionLabel: ps-3 py-1.5 font-face-label text-label tracking-label-role case-label text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.trigger: flex items-center gap-items min-h-ctl-h px-control-x py-2.5 rounded-control border-none cursor-pointer text-left font-body text-ctl bg-transparent text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) font-medium shadow-control-rest hover:bg-hover active:scale-[var(--press-scale)] motion-reduce:active:scale-100
slots.dot: absolute top-1 end-1 w-2 h-2 rounded-pill bg-primary
